forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {遅|おく}らしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to delay; to postpone; to put off; to set back
definitions.explanation: To make something happen later than originally planned or scheduled. Can refer to deliberately pushing back a schedule or causing something to be late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦{遅|おく}らせた→遅らせる：02480_okuraseru⟧。
examples.english: We delayed the departure by one hour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧30{分|ぷん}{遅|おく}らして⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can we push the meeting start time back by 30 minutes?

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪天候|あくてんこう}→悪天候：16184_akutenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遅|おく}らせざる→遅らせる：02480_okuraseru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Due to bad weather, we had no choice but to delay the start of the match.

notes:
USAGE:
The transitive counterpart of ⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ (to be late, intransitive). Used when someone deliberately or actively causes a delay.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遅|おく}らす (to delay departure)
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遅|おく}らす (to push back the time)
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遅|おく}らす (to postpone a plan)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb ({遅|おく}らす → {遅|おく}らさない → {遅|おく}らして). Transitive. The intransitive form is ⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧. Also written as ⟦{遅|おく}らせる→遅らせる：02480_okuraseru⟧ (ichidan, causative form of ⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧), which is more common in modern usage.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{延期|えんき}する→延期する：02517_enkisuru⟧: to postpone — more formal, used for events and official dates
- ⟦{先延|さきの}ばしにする→先延ばしにする：24384_sakinobashinisuru⟧: to put off — more casual, often implies procrastination
